newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-F.A. CUP FINAL FACTFILE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-F.A. CUP FINAL FACTFILE.

text.p: Ruud Gullit will become the first overseas coach to lead out a team at the English F.A. Cup final when Chelsea play Middlesbrough on Saturday.
Other trivia relating to the match:

-- No Italian player has ever played in the English Cup Final, but as many as five could be involved in Saturday's match -- Gianfranco Zola, Gianluca Vialli and Roberto di Matteo of Chelsea; Fabrizio Ravanelli and Gianluca Festa of Middlesbrough.

-- Mark Hughes will become the first player to play for four winning Cup Final sides at Wembley if Chelsea are victorious. He was in Manchester United's winning teams of 1985, 1990 and 1994 when he scored one of United's four goals against Chelsea. He will also become only the 12th player in history to play in five finals.

Juninho and Emerson will become the first Brazilians to play in the Cup Final, but not the first South Americans. Argentina's Osvaldo Ardiles and Ricardo Villa played for Tottenham in 1981 while Chileans George and Ted Robledo played for Newcastle United, George in 1951 and 1952, Ted in 1952.
Villa scored twice for Tottenham in the 1981 Cup Final replay, George Robledo scored Newcastle's winner when they beat Arsenal 1-0 in 1952.

-- Chelsea came close to becoming the first and only club ever to play at home in an F.A. Cup Final in 1920. Chelsea reached the semifinal where they lost 3-1 to Aston Villa. The venue for the final that year was Stamford Bridge. In the event Aston Villa went on to beat Huddersfield 1-0.
-- Peter Osgood of Chelsea in 1970 is the last player to score a goal from in every round of the F.A. Cup from the third round, when the top division teams enter, through to the final.
-- When Chelsea beat Leeds United to win the F.A. Cup in 1970 after extra-time in a replay at Old Trafford, they only led for 16 of the 240 minutes of playing time over the two matches.

-- That was Chelsea's only F.A. Cup win. There other finals have all ended in defeat. In 1915 they lost 3-0 to Sheffield United, in 1967 the lost 2-1 to Tottenham and in 1994 they were beaten 4-0 by Manchester United.

-- Middlesbrough have the chance to make F.A. Cup history by becoming the first club ever to win the Cup and be relegated in the same season. Manchester City (1926), Leicester (1969) and Brighton (1983) all reached the Cup Final in the same season as being relegated. All three lost in the final.
-- Middlesbrough had never reached a major final in their 121-year history until this season when they reached the League Cup Final and lost to Leicester after a replay.
-- Middlesbrough manager Bryan Robson is the only man ever to captain three winning Cup Final teams at Wembley, leading Manchester United to victory in 1983, 1985 and 1990.
